title: Yellowed Crisp Moroccan Lamb Kebabs
description: A briny and crisp Moroccan dish featuring lamb mince and pickle, perfect for a crowd, and plant-based friendly with substitutions.

ingredients.name: lamb mince
ingredients.notes: or plant-based substitute like seitan or mushrooms

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix the lamb mince, pickle, onion, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Use your hands to mix the ingredients until they are just combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers for 20 minutes, or until they are cooked through and lightly browned.
Remove the skewers from the oven and brush them with lemon juice.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
